title: Find and fix a bug across two files
prompt: A small module is split across `slugify.js` and `index.js`. `index.js` exports `makeSlug(title)` which should lowercase the title, trim it, and replace runs of non-alphanumeric characters with single hyphens, with no leading/trailing hyphen (e.g. "  Hello, World!  " -> "hello-world"). One of the two files has a bug. Use fs_search / fs_read_file to locate it, fix it, and make `node --test verify.test.js` pass. Do NOT modify the test file.
